name: AMC 10/12
description: American Mathematics Competitions 10 and 12 are standardized multiple-choice math contests for high school students, consisting of 30 problems each. AMC 10 covers material up to 10th grade, while AMC 12 covers pre-calculus topics. Used as a qualifying round for AIME.
reputation: Prestigious high school math competition administered by the Mathematical Association of America; gateway to AIME and ultimately USAMO/IMO
notes: Annual competition with new problems each year. Problems range from straightforward (early questions) to quite difficult (later questions). Often used to evaluate math reasoning in LLMs alongside AIME.
